disambiguation: Not an AI chat client; it catalogs and resumes Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode sessions.
extras: macOS-only; starts a local Python server on 127.0.0.1:8787; optional AI features send data to Anthropic or OpenAI only after a preview.
problem: Coding-agent sessions are scattered across terminal histories and files, with no single place to search, monitor or resume them.

relations.evidence: brings Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode 2 sessions into one searchable catalog
